mLocKeys.keySummary: Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that deals @Calc_HealthDamage@ max Health magic damage, Slows by @Calc_Slow@ for @SlowDuration@ seconds and marks champions and monsters for @MarkDuration@ seconds. Marked enemies continuously Awaken nearby graves (but not exceeding the maximum of @Spell.YorickPassive:YorickPassiveGhoulMax@) and suffer @ArmorShred*100@% reduced Armor.

Yorick and his summoned units gain @HasteAmount*100@% Move Speed toward the mark. Mist Walkers will leap once at marked enemies that get away from them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Deals a minimum of @Calc_MinimumDamage@ magic damage to lane Minions.
Deals a maximum of @Calc_MonsterCapDamage@ magic damage to jungle Monsters.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Frenzied</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is hasted while moving toward the mark.</mainText>
<titleLeft>Cursed</titleLeft><mainText>Yorick's minions will gain Move Speed and attack this unit.</mainText>

Shepherd of SoulsThe Cursed Horde: Yorick can have up to @f6@ Mist Walkers in an area with @f1@ (+@f2@) Health and @f3@ (+@f4@) Attack Damage.

Final Service: Every @f7@th enemy that dies near Yorick will leave a grave. Enemy champions will always leave a grave.

If Yorick's minions enter combat in a lane, they will proceed down the lane.

mLocKeys.keySummary: <font color='#FF9900'>The Cursed Horde:</font> Yorick can summon Mist Walkers to swarm and attack nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Yorick raises a grave for every @YorickPassiveSpawnThreshold@ enemies that die near him. Champions and large monsters always leave a grave.

These graves can be used to Awaken Mist Walkers with @YorickPassiveGhoulHealth@ Health and @YorickPassiveGhoulDamage@ Attack Damage, up to @YorickPassiveGhoulMax@ in an area.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:

Mist Walkers
Deal @YorickGhoulDamageReductionVsTowers*100@% damage to structures.
Deal @GhoulMonsterDamageMod*100@% damage to jungle monsters.
Take @MeleeAttackDamageModifier*100@% damage from melee Champion Attacks.
Take @AoEDamageModifier@ damage from area of effect damage.
Take @MinionDamageTakenMod*100@% damage from lane Minions.
Take @MonsterDamageTakenMod*100@% damage from jungle Monsters.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Final Service</titleLeft><mainText>Yorick is preparing to dig a grave.</mainText>
<titleLeft>Final Service</titleLeft><mainText>The next enemy that dies near Yorick will leave a grave.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself. If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Yorick's next Attack deals an additional @BonusDamage@ physical damage and restores @QHeal@ plus @MissingHealthRatio@% of his missing Health, reduced by @HealReduction@% against non-Champions. If this Attack hits a Champion or large Monster or kills the target, it leaves a grave.

When there are 3 or more graves nearby and this Ability has already been used, Yorick can Recast to raise Mist Walkers from all nearby graves.
Yorick raises <keywordMajor>Mist Walkers</keywordMajor> from nearby graves.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Last Rites</titleLeft><mainText>Yorick's next basic attack will deal bonus damage and heal him. If it kills the target it will leave a grave.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist that causes Yorick's attacks against the Maiden's target to deal bonus damage. The Maiden will also automatically raise Walkers from dead enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist with @YorickBigGhoulHealth@ Health and @YorickBigGhoulDamage@ Magic Attack Damage plus @RGhoulNumbers@ Mist Walkers. The Maiden automatically raises Mist Walkers from nearby enemy deaths and marks enemy Champions with her attacks. When Yorick damages the Maiden's target, he deals @RMarkDamagePercent@% max Health magic damage.

After 10 seconds, Yorick can Recast this Ability to free the Maiden, sending her down the nearest lane.

<titleLeft>Touch of the Maiden</titleLeft><mainText>Yorick's attacks against this target will cause extra damage.</mainText>
<titleLeft>Final Service</titleLeft><mainText>Yorick is preparing to dig a grave.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Yorick summons a wall of spirits blocking enemies' path, but not allies'. The wall has <healing>@WallHealthTooltip@ Health</healing> and disappears after @CircleDuration@ seconds.
